Coast to Coast AM is an American late-night radio talk show that delves into topics such as the paranormal, conspiracy theories, and fringe science. Created by [[Art Bell]] in 1988, the program gained a massive following, airing on over 600 affiliates and becoming one of the most popular overnight shows in the country. After Bell's retirement, [[George Noory]] took over as the primary host.

Alex has been a guest on Coast to Coast AM, notably in the aftermath of the [[Boston Marathon Bombing]] (covered in [[359: It's All Legs]]). Coast to Coast AM has also come up during [[Project Camelot]] episodes like [[125: Project Camelot's War In Heaven]], where it's discussed how a guest on the show, [[Courtney Brown]], is partially responsible for the Heaven's Gate suicide cult.
